instruction: Navigate to View > Master Slides, click on the slide number placeholder text, and apply blue color from the formatting toolbar

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: This task requires the agent to navigate to master slides view and change the slide number color to blue. The evaluator verifies the color by parsing the slide master XML and checking that the page number placeholder has blue color formatting applied.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly targets slide number placeholders using proper XPath query with ph[@type='sldNum']
Logic properly searches within the slide number placeholder for color formatting in multiple locations (text run properties, paragraph properties, text body)
Color verification uses threshold-based RGB comparison which is appropriate for fuzzy color matching
Postconfig includes Ctrl+S to save file before verification, ensuring fresh state
Complete coverage: instruction requires applying blue color to slide numbers, evaluator checks exactly that
Error handling returns 0.0 on exceptions, preventing crashes
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider documenting which color location takes precedence when color is found in multiple formatting levels (currently returns first found)
